integrity: The exact interval-projection norm is proved by a four-atom transport identity and explicit extremizing molecules. Forty-eight finite-cube dual linear programs crosscheck the statement but do not establish the infinite theorem. The literature comparison is a same-model review, not an independent audit.
limitations: Real Lipschitz-free spaces over full weighted binary Cantor products and the specified coordinate-truncation filtration only; no claim of an optimal decomposition among all filtrations. Qualitative metric approximation was already known for compact invariant-metric groups.
title: Exact interval-projection norms for weighted Cantor Lipschitz-free spaces
